description: This file is a React functional component named AgentInfoView that displays detailed information about an agent, including an overview and admin settings for editing agent configurations. It interacts with networking functions to fetch and update agent data, and uses various React hooks for state management and side effects.

methods.name: AgentInfoView
methods.description: React functional component that displays agent details, handles fetching, editing, and updating agent info, with tabs for overview and settings.

methods.name: fetchAgentInfo
methods.description: Fetches agent info from server and updates state accordingly, also detects agent type for conditional form parsing.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles form submission to update agent data by calling patchAgentCall and re-fetching info.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Helper to format date strings into local date-time format.
